profile_text.body:
The Machine Intelligence Research Institute, or MIRI, is a nonprofit founded in 2000 and headquartered in Berkeley, California. Its website describes it as focused on preventing human extinction from artificial superintelligence.

The site says MIRI has worked for over two decades to understand and prepare for the challenges it expects humanity to face in a transition to a world with artificial superintelligence. It states that its technical and philosophical work helped found the field of AI alignment, and that its researchers originated many of the theories and concepts central to current discussions of AI. The site also says recent rapid advances at the frontier of artificial intelligence have dramatically shortened estimates of when superintelligence will arrive, that technical progress on safety, alignment, and control has failed to keep up, and that humanity does not understand the internal workings of present systems well enough to completely control them or robustly steer their behavior, let alone the more powerful systems it expects in coming years.

No lawsuits involving the organization are recorded. Its recorded legal exposure is in California, with a count of 281. No AI products or MCP servers are listed for it.
